name: Oc huong
summary: Ốc hương biển hấp sả is a spotted sea snail steamed with lemongrass. The meat is cleanly sweet and tastes of the sea.
origin: Can Gio. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, on the town streets, without a cook.
howToEat: The 2014 cook is steamed with lemongrass. The 2022 diner does not say how it was cooked.
where: The 2022 plate was on the town streets. The 2014 story names no street.
seoTitle: Oc huong — lemongrass snail in Can Gio
seoDescription: Ốc hương biển hấp sả is a spotted sea snail steamed with lemongrass, cleanly sweet and tasting of the sea.
taste: Clean sweetness and a sea smell, with the spots the 2014 story mentions.
